name: Candidate narrates two overlapping full-time internship windows — BGV tell

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Sure. I did my first internship at a Bangalore fintech from May 2024 to August 2024 — full-time, built a notification microservice in Node.js. Then my second internship was at an EdTech startup from June 2024 to October 2024, where I worked on the React dashboard. Both were full-time roles and I learned a lot from each.
